new_symbol_range_suggestions.g_occ: positive real-valued effective thermodynamic weight, varied across conditions; choose values comparable to g_emp and strictly > 0 so the logarithm remains defined
new_symbol_range_suggestions.c_occ_ex: real-valued with 1 + c_occ_ex*T/(1 + T) > 0 over the sampled positive-T range; choose moderate magnitude so the entropic modulation is subleading at low T and becomes observable only over the upper part of the admissible T range

derivation_notes: The grand-canonical single-occupancy form is retained, but the occupied manifold is allowed to acquire additional thermally accessible unresolved sublevels. This is modeled by replacing the constant occupied statistical weight with g_occ*(1 + c_occ_ex*T/(1 + T)), which adds a distinct temperature-dependent entropic contribution inside the logarithm.
change_summary: The fixed occupied-degeneracy assumption was relaxed by promoting g_occ to a controllable effective thermodynamic weight and modulating it by temperature-dependent sublevel accessibility. This changes the target mapping through entropy-driven bending of the half-occupation threshold rather than only through another additive energy correction.

assumption_audit.released_assumption: The occupied and empty manifold degeneracy factors are strictly temperature-independent constants across the sampled range.
assumption_audit.mechanism: Thermal activation of unresolved sublevels changes the effective entropy of the occupied manifold, so its baseline thermodynamic weight must be allowed to vary across conditions and is further modulated by temperature.
assumption_audit.parent_reduction: At the reference condition g_occ = 1 and in the limit c_occ_ex -> 0, the successor reduces to the parent with constant occupied degeneracy equal to 1.

response_change.parent_relation: The parent maps occupation through a single logistic threshold in Delta whose temperature dependence is entirely additive in the effective offset, so changing T only shifts the midpoint and width in a separable way.
response_change.child_relation: Relax the assumption of temperature-independent microstate multiplicities so that the occupied-empty entropy difference itself varies with T, making the occupation threshold in Delta acquire additional T-dependent curvature beyond an additive offset shift.
response_change.observable_effect: At fixed degeneracy ratio inferred from low T, the Delta value giving n_bar=1/2 bends with T in a way not captured by any refit of the existing polynomial offset alone; equivalently, the slope-versus-T at fixed Delta changes differently on opposite sides of the crossover.

evolution_contract.activation_condition: Visible when positive T is high enough that unresolved excited sublevels inside the occupied or empty manifold become thermally populated, but still in a regime where the level remains effectively single-occupancy and the smooth equilibrium description is valid.
evolution_contract.train_hidden_contrast: Across the sampled T range the parent can only express thermal effects through one additive polynomial free-energy correction plus a constant entropy ratio, whereas the refinement adds a distinct T-dependent entropic contribution that changes the Delta threshold curvature and extends naturally into holdout at higher T.
evolution_contract.continuation_path: Recover the parent when the extra thermal accessibility of manifold sublevels vanishes, so the occupied and empty degeneracy factors reduce to T-independent constants over the observed range.
evolution_contract.promotion_reason: A temperature-dependent entropic weighting cannot be represented if the multiplicity ratio is fixed. Releasing one degeneracy parameter as an externally varied effective thermodynamic weight is the minimal way to test and encode nonconstant manifold accessibility without adding unrelated state dynamics.
evolution_contract.scientific_mechanism: Thermal activation of unresolved sublevels changes the effective entropy of the occupied manifold, so its statistical weight is not constant over the sampled temperature window.
evolution_contract.difficulty_rationale: The refinement is structurally harder than a coefficient-only correction because the promoted condition g_occ now participates in a multiplicative thermal modulation inside the entropic logarithm, creating a distinct threshold-surface deformation rather than only shifting the energetic offset polynomial.
evolution_contract.assumption_before: The parent assumes fixed degeneracy factors g_occ and g_emp across all temperatures.
evolution_contract.assumption_after: The occupied manifold has thermally activated unresolved sublevels, so its effective statistical weight is g_occ*(1 + c_occ_ex*T/(1 + T)) rather than a temperature-independent constant.
evolution_contract.after_fragment: 1/(exp((Delta + c_ex*T**2 + c_ex3*T**3 + c_ex4*T**4 - T*log((g_occ*(1 + c_occ_ex*T/(1 + T)))/g_emp))/T) + 1)
evolution_contract.parent_reduction: Set c_occ_ex = 0 to recover the parent exactly.
evolution_contract.observable_signature: At fixed g_occ and g_emp, scanning T shifts the n_bar=1/2 contour from the parent half_occ_line by an extra entropic bend coming from T*log(1 + c_occ_ex*T/(1 + T)); the Delta threshold therefore acquires additional T-dependent curvature that becomes visible once thermally accessible sublevels matter while single-occupancy remains valid.
evolution_contract.shortcut_blocked: A single parent parameter set cannot reproduce this contrast across the admissible T range because its only thermal freedom is an additive polynomial reorganization plus a constant entropy ratio. Refitting c_ex, c_ex3, and c_ex4 can mimic one portion of the threshold curve, but it cannot simultaneously preserve the low-T degeneracy-controlled behavior and the higher-T entropy-driven curvature generated by the child term inside log((g_occ*(1 + c_occ_ex*T/(1 + T)))/g_emp).

evolution_plan.activation_condition: Visible when positive T is high enough that unresolved excited sublevels inside the occupied or empty manifold become thermally populated, but still in a regime where the level remains effectively single-occupancy and the smooth equilibrium description is valid.
evolution_plan.train_hidden_contrast: Across the sampled T range the parent can only express thermal effects through one additive polynomial free-energy correction plus a constant entropy ratio, whereas the refinement adds a distinct T-dependent entropic contribution that changes the Delta threshold curvature and extends naturally into holdout at higher T.
evolution_plan.continuation_path: Recover the parent when the extra thermal accessibility of manifold sublevels vanishes, so the occupied and empty degeneracy factors reduce to T-independent constants over the observed range.
evolution_plan.promotion_reason: A temperature-dependent entropic weighting cannot be represented if the multiplicity ratio is fixed. Releasing one degeneracy parameter as an externally varied effective thermodynamic weight is the minimal way to test and encode nonconstant manifold accessibility without adding unrelated state dynamics.
evolution_plan.gap_statement: The model treats occupied and empty manifold multiplicities as strictly temperature-independent constants, even though unresolved internal sublevels can make the effective statistical weight of a manifold vary with temperature.
evolution_plan.baseline_assumption: The parent assumes fixed degeneracy factors g_occ and g_emp across all temperatures.
evolution_plan.scientific_mechanism: Thermal activation of unresolved sublevels changes the effective entropy of the occupied manifold, so its statistical weight is not constant over the sampled temperature window.
evolution_plan.rationale: A realistic next refinement is to relax the fixed-degeneracy assumption rather than append another small energy polynomial. In the parent, varying T at fixed Delta changes n_bar only through the existing additive free-energy reorganization terms and the linear-in-T entropy term from a constant log(g_occ/g_emp). This imposes a single threshold surface in (Delta,T): for any refitted parameter set, the T dependence of the half-occupation line is constrained to the current polynomial-offset form plus a constant entropy ratio. If unresolved occupied-manifold sublevels become thermally accessible over part of the admissible positive-T range, the effective entropy difference between occupied and empty configurations changes with T itself. Then, holding Delta fixed and scanning T, the occupation crossover can steepen or flatten in a way not reproducible by merely refitting c_ex, c_ex3, and c_ex4 with one shared parameter set, because those coefficients only alter the energetic offset while the entropic weighting multiplies T through a distinct functional channel. The effect is scientifically admissible when excitation energies are comparable to the upper sampled thermal scale but low enough that all sublevels still belong to the same single-occupancy level rather than to a separate independently occupied level. This changes the scored target mapping n_bar(Delta,T), not just an auxiliary interpretation, and reduces back to the parent when the effective degeneracies are constant over T.

selected_embedding_pattern.description: Use a declared condition to modulate the strength of an existing process.

scenario_text: Consider a single quantum level exchanging indistinguishable particles with a large equilibrium reservoir. The level can hold at most one particle, so thermal fluctuations produce a smooth transition between mostly occupied and mostly empty states. The target is the mean occupation probability as the level offset and reservoir temperature are varied independently. The reservoir remains macroscopically unchanged by occupation of the level.
